title: Financial Analyst
must_have: 3+ years of experience in corporate finance
text:
Financial Analyst
Godavari Finserv | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a financial analyst to join our corporate finance team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Financial Modelling
- Advanced Excel
- Variance Analysis
- Financial Reporting
- Budgeting
- 3+ years of experience in corporate finance

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Power BI
- GST Compliance
- SAP FICO
- Ind AS

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive annual operating plan with measurable outcomes.
- Drive cost-centre review process with measurable outcomes.
- Drive monthly close cycle with measurable outcomes.
